faqs.a: Yes. Posting a tuition requirement is free. Students never pay a platform fee or subscription. You only pay your tutor as agreed in the signed contract.
A one-time registration of ₹199 (GST inclusive), and a one-time commission of 30% of the monthly fee (GST inclusive) per student when the agreement becomes active. There is no monthly subscription.

Tutors upload identity and qualification documents (Aadhaar, PAN, degree). An admin reviews them. Profile completeness and search discoverability require admin approval — unverified tutors stay hidden. Approved tutors also receive a verified badge. Contact details stay hidden from public profiles.

faqs.q: When can we share phone numbers or chat?
faqs.a: After both of you sign and the agreement is ACTIVE. Until then, use demo booking only — so numbers aren't leaked into group chats.
A scheduled trial session between a shortlisted student and tutor. It lives on the calendar. It is how you decide if the teaching fits — not a sales call.
A dual-signed PDF covering parties, fee, schedule, and mode. When it becomes ACTIVE, slots can be occupied, in-app chat unlocks, and tutor commission applies as shown at checkout.

faqs.q: Can we learn online and at home?
faqs.a: Yes. Requirements and tutor profiles include mode and a teaching radius. Pick what fits your week.
Open a dispute in the app with evidence. Admin reviews the case. You can also email the help desk. This does not replace remedies under Indian law.
Yes. The full student, tutor, and admin experience is available in Hindi and English. Switch anytime from the header.

faqs.q: Do I need an invite code?
faqs.a: During invite-only soft launch, registration may ask for an invite code or an allowlisted email. If you were invited, use the code from your email. If the field is hidden, open registration is on.

legal.termsIntro: These Terms govern use of TutorConnect India ("Platform"), a marketplace that connects students seeking tuition with independent tutors. By creating an account or using the Platform you agree to these Terms. Soft-launch / beta users receive the same protections and obligations.

termsSections.heading: 1. Roles and accounts
termsSections.body: Each account has one role: Student, Tutor, or Admin. You must provide accurate information and keep credentials confidential. We may suspend accounts that violate these Terms, fail verification, or abuse payments.

termsSections.heading: 2. Marketplace relationship
termsSections.body: TutorConnect facilitates discovery, demos, agreements, and scheduling. Tutors are independent providers — not employees of TutorConnect. Students contract with tutors under digitally signed agreements generated on the Platform.

termsSections.heading: 3. Fees (tutors only)
termsSections.body: Students post requirements free of charge. Tutors pay a one-time registration fee (₹199 incl. GST) and a one-time commission of 30% of the agreed monthly tuition fee (GST inclusive) per student engagement, as shown at checkout. There is no subscription module in the current product.

termsSections.heading: 4. Demos, chat, and privacy of contact
termsSections.body: Before an agreement is ACTIVE, direct contact details stay private; demos are the trial path. After both parties sign and the agreement becomes ACTIVE, in-app chat may be used. Do not harass other users or share content that is illegal or harmful.

termsSections.heading: 5. Verification, ratings, and disputes
termsSections.body: Tutors may upload identity and qualification documents for admin review. Ratings are available after a completed engagement. Disputes may be opened with evidence; admin decisions on the Platform are operational and do not replace remedies available under Indian law.

termsSections.heading: 6. Payments
termsSections.body: Tutor payments are processed via Razorpay (or a documented mock mode in non-production). You authorize us to collect fees disclosed at checkout. Refunds, if any, follow Platform policy and payment-provider rules.

termsSections.heading: 7. Soft launch / invite access
termsSections.body: During invite-only soft launch, registration may require a valid invite code or allowlisted email. We may limit capacity, change features, or reset test data with notice to beta participants.

termsSections.heading: 8. Liability and governing law
termsSections.body: The Platform is provided on an "as available" basis for marketplace facilitation. To the extent permitted by law, TutorConnect is not liable for tutoring outcomes, tutor conduct off-platform, or outages beyond reasonable control. These Terms are governed by the laws of India. For notices contact the support email published on the Platform.

termsSections.heading: 9. Changes
termsSections.body: We may update these Terms for legal or product reasons. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use after posting constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

legal.privacyIntro: This Policy explains how TutorConnect India collects, uses, and protects personal data when you use our website and API. We process data to operate a verified tutor marketplace in India.

privacySections.heading: 1. Data we collect
privacySections.body: Account data (name, email, mobile, role, locale); profile data (bio, subjects, location/pincode, photos); verification documents (e.g. ID/qualification uploads and optional document numbers); marketplace activity (requirements, matches, demos, agreements, schedules, chat after ACTIVE agreement); payment metadata (amounts, status, gateway references — card data is handled by Razorpay); technical logs and audit events for security and admin actions.

privacySections.heading: 2. How we use data
privacySections.body: To create and secure accounts (OTP, passwords, sessions); match students and tutors; run demos, agreements, and schedules; process tutor fees; verify tutors; handle ratings and disputes; send transactional email; improve reliability and prevent fraud; comply with law.

privacySections.heading: 3. Legal basis and retention
privacySections.body: We process data to perform the contract for Platform services and for legitimate interests in security and marketplace integrity. We retain account and transaction records as needed for operations, disputes, and legal retention, then delete or anonymize when no longer required.

privacySections.heading: 4. Sharing
privacySections.body: We share data with processors that help us run the service: hosting/database, email (SMTP), file storage (Cloudinary), payments (Razorpay), and optional error monitoring (Sentry). We do not sell personal data. Counterparties see limited information as required for demos/agreements (contact remains gated until ACTIVE).

privacySections.heading: 5. Security
privacySections.body: We use HTTPS in production deployments, hashed passwords (bcrypt), hashed refresh tokens and OTPs, optional AES encryption for document numbers, role-based access control, and audited admin document views. No method of transmission is 100% secure; report suspected incidents to support.

privacySections.heading: 6. Your choices
privacySections.body: You may update profile data in-app, request account closure via support, and withdraw optional document numbers where the product allows. Soft-launch invitees may ask to leave the beta at any time.

privacySections.heading: 7. Children
privacySections.body: Accounts are intended for adults managing tuition (parents/guardians or adult students). Do not submit a child's government ID unless you are authorized and the Platform flow requires it for verification.

privacySections.heading: 8. Contact
privacySections.body: Privacy questions: use the support email shown on the Platform footer and in the ops playbook. We will respond within a reasonable time during soft launch.

legal.agreementIntro: When a student and tutor both sign in-app, TutorConnect generates a PDF agreement that becomes the binding record for that engagement. The live PDF (not this page) controls schedule, fee, and mode for each pair.

agreementSections.heading: What the PDF includes
agreementSections.body: Parties' names; subject/class context; monthly tuition fee; schedule slots (day/time/mode); buffer and occupy/release rules as implemented on the Platform; signatures with timestamps.

agreementSections.heading: When it becomes active
agreementSections.body: After both signatures, the agreement status becomes ACTIVE, matching slots may be occupied, chat unlocks, and tutor commission obligations apply as disclosed in product fees.

agreementSections.heading: Changes and disputes
agreementSections.body: Schedule releases are handled in-app by the student where allowed. Disputes with evidence can be filed for admin review. Serious issues should also use appropriate offline legal remedies.
